prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1349; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured reports the other vehicle drifted into the adjacent lane while signaling late. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles received from insured and await review.

Entry 2: Claimant's representing attorney's office contacted this unit and confirmed representation. All further communication to go through counsel. Claimant reports a concussion with headaches, light sensitivity, and dizziness. Medical authorization forms sent to counsel.

Entry 3: Liability review in progress. Insured's dashcam footage partially supports the claimant's account of the lane change. Witness statement obtained from a passenger in the insured vehicle. Preliminary assessment places majority fault on the insured pending full review of the police report.

Entry 4: Received medical records from claimant's treating neurologist. Diagnosis documented as mild traumatic brain injury with post-concussive symptoms. Treatment plan includes follow-up imaging and a referral for vestibular therapy. Records forwarded to medical review for evaluation.

Entry 5: Counsel submitted a demand package requesting settlement for bodily injury and property damage. Demand under review by claims supervisor. Reserve adjusted to reflect the injury severity and pending medical costs. Next step: request independent medical examination and schedule a response to counsel within the statutory timeframe.
